by
  let sum_all := (a + b) + (b + c) + (a + c)
  let sum_all' := 5 + 7 + 6

  rw [h1, h2, h3] at h4
  rw [h4, h5]

  constructor
  · rw [add_assoc]
  · rw [add_assoc]
